name: Gruha Lakshmi Scheme
description: A flagship welfare initiative by the Government of Karnataka providing financial empowerment to women heads of families by granting direct monthly financial assistance.
department: Department of Women and Child Development, Government of Karnataka
benefits: Financial assistance of ₹2,000 per month transferred directly via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) into the bank account of the registered woman head of the family.

rules.description: Applicant family must be permanent residents of Karnataka.
Applicant must be designated as the woman head of the family in the official ration card.
Family must possess a valid Antyodaya (AAY), Below Poverty Line (BPL), or Above Poverty Line (APL) ration card issued by Food & Civil Supplies Dept.
Direct beneficiary must be female.

documents.description: Valid Karnataka Ration Card listing the applicant as female head of the family.
Aadhaar card of the woman head of household for biometric e-KYC.
Bank account linked with NPCI / Aadhaar seeding for direct cash transfer.

steps.instruction: Verify ration card status and confirm that applicant is registered as the woman head of family on Ahara Karnataka portal.
Visit designated Seva Kendra (Grama One, Bangalore One, Karnataka One, or Bapuji Seva Kendra).
Provide Ration Card Number and Aadhaar number for biometric e-KYC authentication.
Receive application acknowledgement receipt with unique registration tracking ID.

name: Yuva Nidhi Scheme
description: Unemployment assistance scheme for educated youth in Karnataka who have graduated or completed diplomas and have remained unemployed for more than 180 days.
department: Department of Employment and Training, Government of Karnataka
benefits: Monthly financial aid of ₹3,000 for degree holders (Graduates) and ₹1,500 for diploma holders for a period of up to 2 years or until employment/self-employment is secured.

rules.description: Candidate must have studied in Karnataka for at least 6 consecutive years.
Must possess a recognized degree or diploma from a recognized university/board in Karnataka.
Must not be employed in public or private sector and not pursuing higher education.

documents.document_name: Degree / Diploma Passing Certificate and Marks Cards
documents.description: Official convocation / provisional degree certificate and final semester marks cards.
Study certificate proving a minimum of 6 years study in Karnataka or domicile certificate.
Aadhaar card for biometric identity verification.

documents.document_name: Bank Passbook seeded with NPCI / Aadhaar
documents.description: Bank account where DBT financial assistance will be deposited.

steps.instruction: Open Seva Sindhu Guarantee Scheme Portal and select Yuva Nidhi.
Authenticate using Aadhaar number and OTP.
Enter Degree / Diploma registration number to fetch academic records from Karnataka University database.
Submit self-declaration confirming unemployment status and monthly reporting requirement.

name: Gruha Jyothi Scheme
description: A welfare scheme providing free domestic electricity of up to 200 units per month for households in Karnataka.
department: Energy Department (BESCOM, MESCOM, CESC, HESCOM, GESCOM), Government of Karnataka
benefits: Zero electricity bill for monthly domestic consumption within entitlement limit (average consumption of previous 12 months + 10% buffer, capped at a maximum of 200 units).

rules.description: Domestic electricity connection must be located within Karnataka state.
Monthly electricity consumption must not exceed 200 units on average. Commercial connections are strictly excluded.

documents.document_name: Electricity Consumer Account ID (Account ID on Bill)
documents.description: Unique 10-digit Account ID mentioned on domestic monthly electricity bill.
Aadhaar number of the homeowner or tenant residing in the premises.

documents.document_name: Rental / Tenancy Agreement or Voter ID (for Tenants)
documents.description: Proof of occupancy in case applicant is a tenant living in rented accommodation.

steps.instruction: Access Seva Sindhu Gruha Jyothi portal or visit Grama One / Bangalore One center.
Select your Electricity Supply Company (ESCOM: BESCOM, MESCOM, CESC, HESCOM, or GESCOM).
Enter your Consumer Account ID and complete Aadhaar authentication.
Download acknowledgement receipt confirming registration for zero electricity billing.

name: Shakti Scheme
description: Free public bus travel initiative for women and transgender residents across state-operated road transport buses throughout Karnataka.
department: Transport Department (KSRTC, BMTC, NWKRTC, KKRTC), Government of Karnataka
benefits: 100% free bus travel in ordinary and express city and intercity bus services operated by KSRTC, BMTC, NWKRTC, and KKRTC within the state of Karnataka.

rules.description: Beneficiary must be a resident of Karnataka.
Eligible for all women and transgender residents.

documents.document_name: Government Photo ID with Karnataka Address
documents.description: Any valid government photo ID card proving Karnataka residency (Aadhaar, Voter ID, Driving License, or Ration Card).

steps.instruction: Board any eligible ordinary or express bus operated by BMTC, KSRTC, NWKRTC, or KKRTC within Karnataka.
Show your original government photo identity card proving Karnataka residence to the bus conductor.
The conductor verifies the ID and issues a zero-fare ticket for your journey.

name: Anna Bhagya Scheme
description: Food security scheme providing 10 kg of foodgrains per person per month for Antyodaya and BPL ration cardholder families across Karnataka.
department: Food, Civil Supplies & Consumer Affairs Department, Government of Karnataka
benefits: Entitlement of 10 kg foodgrains per person per month (5 kg Central PMGKAY foodgrain + 5 kg additional grain or direct cash transfer of ₹34 per kg for the additional 5 kg via DBT during procurement constraints).

rules.description: Beneficiary must reside in Karnataka with active ration card record.
Must possess an active Priority Household (BPL) or Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY) ration card.
Applicant family must be officially certified below poverty line.

documents.description: Official ration card issued by Food, Civil Supplies & Consumer Affairs Department.
Aadhaar cards linked to the RCMS database for biometric authentication.

documents.document_name: Aadhaar-Linked Bank Account (for DBT Cash Component)
documents.description: Active bank account seeded with Aadhaar and NPCI for cash payment transfers.

steps.instruction: Visit the Karnataka Ahara portal and check your Ration Card status and member details.
Verify that your bank account is active and seeded with NPCI/Aadhaar on the Ahara DBT status portal.
Collect free foodgrains from your assigned Fair Price Shop (FPS) using e-POS biometric authentication.

name: State Scholarship Portal (SSP) Post-Matric Scholarships
description: Unified Karnataka scholarship portal providing financial support and fee reimbursement to SC, ST, OBC, Minority, and EWS students pursuing post-matric courses.
department: Social Welfare, Tribal Welfare, BCWD, and Minorities Welfare Departments, Government of Karnataka
benefits: Tuition fee reimbursement, examination fee waiver, and monthly maintenance allowance directly credited to the student's Aadhaar-linked bank account.

rules.description: Student must be a resident of Karnataka.
Must be actively studying in PUC, Diploma, ITI, Graduate, Post-Graduate, or Doctoral degree.
SC, ST, OBC, Minority or General category students with valid Nadakacheri income certificate.
Annual household income must not exceed ₹2.5 Lakhs (up to ₹10 Lakhs for select SC/ST fee concession categories).

documents.document_name: Student SATS ID / College Registration Number
documents.description: Student Achievement Tracking System ID or university admission number.
Official Nadakacheri RD number for digital verification of caste and income.
College fee receipt and bonafide student study certificate.
Student's Aadhaar and bank account seeded with NPCI for DBT transfer.

steps.instruction: Create account on Karnataka State Scholarship Portal (SSP) using student Aadhaar number.
Fetch Caste and Income Certificate details by submitting the Nadakacheri RD Number.
Enter college, course, and hostel details for electronic verification by the institution.
Submit application and monitor verification status through the SSP dashboard.

name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
description: Central sector income support scheme providing direct financial transfer to all landholding farmer families across India.
department: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Government of India
benefits: Direct income benefit of ₹6,000 per year transferred in three equal four-monthly installments of ₹2,000 directly into the bank accounts of farmer families.

rules.description: Applicant must be a farmer family owning cultivable land.
Must possess cultivable land registered in State land records in the farmer's name.

documents.document_name: Land Record Documents (Record of Rights / RTC / Patta / Khata)
documents.description: Official land title document verifying land ownership in the applicant's name.
Aadhaar card mandatory for beneficiary identity and DBT transfer.
Active bank account seeded with Aadhaar and mapped with NPCI mapper.

steps.instruction: Visit PM-KISAN portal -> Farmers Corner -> Click 'New Farmer Registration'.
Select Rural or Urban Farmer Registration, enter Aadhaar number, state, and mobile number.
Enter land holding survey number, dag/khasra number, and upload land ownership certificate.
Complete biometric or OTP-based e-KYC to activate installment payments.

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (PMAY)
description: Comprehensive housing mission providing financial assistance to homeless families and households living in kutcha or dilapidated houses to build pucca homes.
department: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs & Ministry of Rural Development, Government of India
benefits: Direct grant of ₹1.2 Lakh (plain areas) to ₹1.3 Lakh (hilly/difficult areas) for rural construction, or interest subsidy up to ₹2.67 Lakhs on home loans for urban beneficiaries.

rules.description: Household income up to ₹3 Lakhs for EWS and ₹3 to ₹6 Lakhs for LIG category.

documents.description: Government photo identity proof of applicant and family members.
Certificate from competent revenue authority confirming household annual income.

documents.document_name: Land / Plot Ownership Document or Allotment Letter
documents.description: Proof of land ownership where the house will be constructed.

documents.document_name: Affidavit of No Pucca House Ownership
documents.description: Self-declaration confirming that neither the applicant nor family members own a pucca house in India.

steps.instruction: Open PMAY Citizen Assessment portal or approach the local Gram Panchayat / Urban Local Body.
Verify Aadhaar number and fill socio-economic details under Citizen Assessment.
Submit land details, current house type (kutcha), and bank account details.
Undergo physical inspection and geotagging of house construction progress to receive installment grants.

name: Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY)
description: The world's largest health assurance scheme providing free hospitalization health insurance coverage to vulnerable and low-income families across India.
department: National Health Authority (NHA), Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Government of India
benefits: Cashless and paperless inpatient healthcare cover of up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization across empaneled public and private hospitals.

rules.description: Family must be listed in SECC 2011 deprivation criteria or hold a valid BPL / NFSA ration card.
Must possess a BPL or Antyodaya (AAY) ration card for state-aligned health schemes (like AB-ArK in Karnataka).

documents.description: Ration card verifying family enrollment in priority household database.
Aadhaar card of all family members to create Ayushman Cards.

steps.instruction: Open the official NHA Beneficiary Portal to check family eligibility using mobile number or ration card.
Select your state (e.g. Karnataka) and search by Ration Card (Family ID) or Aadhaar.
Complete e-KYC for each family member using Aadhaar OTP, iris, or fingerprint.
Download the Ayushman Card for cashless admission at any empaneled hospital nationwide.

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY)
description: Government-backed savings scheme aimed at the welfare and higher education of girl children, featuring guaranteed high interest and triple tax benefits under Section 80C.
department: Department of Posts / Department of Economic Affairs, Ministry of Finance, Government of India
benefits: Government-guaranteed interest rate (8.2% p.a.), exempt-exempt-exempt (EEE) tax status, partial withdrawal for higher education after age 18, and maturity on reaching 21 years.

rules.description: Account can only be opened for a girl child.
Account must be opened from the birth of the girl child up to the age of 10 years.

documents.document_name: Birth Certificate of the Girl Child
documents.description: Official birth certificate issued by municipal corporation, hospital, or registrar of births.

documents.document_name: Identity & Address Proof of Parent / Legal Guardian
documents.description: Aadhaar card, Voter ID, or Passport of the parent/guardian opening the account.

documents.document_name: Photographs of Child and Parent / Guardian
documents.description: Passport-sized photographs for bank or post office passbook.

steps.instruction: Visit any authorized Post Office or commercial bank branch (e.g. SBI, Canara Bank, PNB, Bank of Baroda).
Fill out the Sukanya Samriddhi Account Opening Form-1.
Submit the form along with the girl child's birth certificate and guardian's ID proof.
Make the initial deposit (minimum ₹250) and collect the Sukanya Samriddhi Passbook.
